title: EVIL-AI RAG
star: Visitors to the EVIL AI website couldn't explore the research without manually browsing every paper → built a RAG-powered chatbot (hybrid vector+BM25, cross-encoder reranking) so anyone can ask 'what safety research is ongoing?' or 'how many alignment papers exist?' → deployed on OpenShift and integrated as a live chatbot on the website → visitors now discover the research through conversation, not browsing.
previewCaption: Ask a question → answer grounded in the research papers, with 15 cited sources.

title: LLM Red-Teaming Toolkit
star: Evaluating LLM safety against adversarial prompts was manual and ad-hoc → first prototyped the pipeline as an n8n automation workflow, then rebuilt it as a Python toolkit with automated jailbreak testing (6 heuristic scoring signals) and adversarial variant generation (6 methods: paraphrase, obfuscation, roleplay, injection suffix, suffix concatenation, roundtrip translation) → systematically scores model robustness across multiple LLMs and outputs timestamped JSON findings and summary reports.
previewCaption: Automated workflow probing 4 LLMs → summary report of which models were jailbroken and on which attempt.

title: AI Diagnostic Assistant
star: Patients needed a structured way to self-triage symptoms → built a Streamlit chatbot from scratch in 24 hours using RAG over a medical CSV knowledge base → generates contextual follow-up questions and AI-powered differential diagnoses → includes 'not medical advice' disclaimer throughout.

title: AI Desktop Pet
star: Desktop companions were either too distracting or lacked intelligence → built a cross-platform desktop pet with Tauri (Rust + TypeScript) that lives on your screen, sends smart wellness reminders (water, breaks, stretches), and chats offline or via OpenAI → shipped with system tray controls, custom sprite support, and click-through transparency on macOS and Windows.
previewCaption: The pet roams your screen with friendly wellness nudges: water, breaks, posture.

title: Brain Tumor Classifier
star: CNN classifying brain MRI images — from-scratch model vs. transfer learning on tumour vs. healthy scans.

title: Zomato EDA
star: Exploratory analysis of restaurant data surfacing pricing, rating and cuisine trends.

title: Rock vs Mine Prediction
star: Binary classification on sonar data to distinguish rocks from underwater mines.
